source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to topic 17.2, printed page 3.

blocks.text: Is hisse mein kitab Group 2 metals ke teen tarah ke reactions batati hai: oxygen ke saath (17.2.1), paani ke saath (17.2.2) aur dilute acids (halke tezaab) ke saath (17.2.3). Har jagah ek hi baat nazar aayegi: group mein neeche jate hue reaction tez hota jata hai, kyunke ionization energy kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Group mein neeche jate hue Group 2 metals ke reactions tez kyun hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Neeche atom bara hota hai aur ionization energy kam, is liye do bahar wale electrons aasani se nikal jate hain aur metal jaldi react karta hai.

items: Group 2 metals oxygen, paani aur dilute acids se react karte hain; group mein neeche reaction tez hota hai.
